sources.entry: Pi Stats - macOS app to visualize Pi-hole information.

summary.one_liner: Pi Stats is a native iOS and macOS app for monitoring and quickly enabling or disabling Pi-hole instances (Pi-hole 6.x) from an iPhone, iPad, or Mac menu bar.
summary.what_it_does: The app connects to one or more Pi-hole servers and shows network-wide ad-blocking statistics with charts and metrics. It offers quick enable/disable controls for each Pi-hole. On iOS it includes widget support, and on macOS it runs as a menu bar app. System metrics (temperature, uptime, CPU load, memory) are read from Pi-hole's authenticated API, so no extra service or port is needed. Passwords are stored in the Keychain, and the same password used for the Pi-hole web interface is entered in the app. The README also includes troubleshooting guidance for the apiSeatsExceeded error, which is fixed by raising webserver.api.max_sessions.
use_cases: monitor Pi-hole ad blocking stats from iPhone
check Pi-hole status from Mac menu bar
pause or resume Pi-hole blocking quickly
track stats across multiple Pi-hole instances
view Pi-hole temperature, CPU and memory from phone
how_to_run: Install from the Mac App Store (macOS) or the iOS App Store (iPhone and iPad)
Add your Pi-hole instance and enter the same password used for the Pi-hole web interface
If connections fail with apiSeatsExceeded, increase webserver.api.max_sessions in /etc/pihole/pihole.toml or via Settings → Expert Settings in the Pi-hole web GUI
notable: Native iOS app with widget support and macOS menu bar app
Reads system metrics from Pi-hole's authenticated API without extra services or ports
caveats: iOS requires iOS 26.0 or later; macOS requires macOS Sequoia (15.2) or later
Distributed through the Mac App Store and iOS App Store; README does not state pricing
